context_requirements: Cells must be proliferating and dependent on de novo nucleotide biosynthesis.
DHFR must be expressed and active.
Cells must be able to take up the drug or its active form.
Folate transport and polyglutamation pathways should be functional.
falsifiers: No change in any of the listed proximal or late genes at 6 h or 24 h in any cell line.
Strong upregulation of proliferation markers (e.g., MCM3, PCNA, CCNA2) at 24 h.
No difference in response between cell lines with high versus low proliferation rates.
Lack of any transcriptional response despite confirmed DHFR inhibition.

changes: Removed MTHFD2 from proximal_up because DHFR inhibition does not directly induce MTHFD2 transcription; MTHFD2 is a mitochondrial folate enzyme not an immediate transcriptional target.
Removed MTHFD2 from proximal_down because it was incorrectly listed in both up and down lists and its downregulation is not a direct proximal effect of DHFR inhibition.
